# NP Local Business

> A trusted directory of independent, verified local businesses across the NP postcode area of South Wales, UK - Newport, Cwmbran, Pontypool, Usk, Abergavenny, Monmouth, Chepstow and surrounding communities. Each listing includes verified contact details, opening hours, services and location.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.newportlocalbusiness.co.uk/): overview and featured businesses
- [Categories](https://www.newportlocalbusiness.co.uk/categories): browse all businesses by category
- [Locations](https://www.newportlocalbusiness.co.uk/locations): browse all businesses by town/area
- [Join](https://www.newportlocalbusiness.co.uk/join): list a business on the directory
